steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow needed for a rank-based auction.
Configure the auction strategy and awarding rule required by the setup.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add one line item so the best-price row can be checked for that item.
Complete the pricing sheet before scheduling and publishing.
Commit a live bidding schedule.
Invite two vendors so a lowest bid can be determined across vendors.
Publish the auction so suppliers can bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Confirm the first supplier bid was accepted.
Confirm the second supplier bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's Auction Responses tab required by the case setup.
Confirm both supplier responses are present before enabling best-price visibility.
Open the buyer Responses actions menu.
Select the best-price visibility action requested by the case.
Confirm the buyer screen reports or displays the best-price feature after selection.
Inspect the available supplier portal session after best prices are enabled.
Open the auction pricing view in the supplier portal.
Confirm the supplier view exposes the best-price label.
Confirm the supplier can see the exact lowest bid value.
Return to the buyer's auction page to inspect QCS.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the additional lowest-bid row should appear.
Assert the QCS contains the best-price row with the lowest bid for the line item.
